title: US-short §13 lifecycle calibration register — the dynamic per-item live-forward accumulator that us_short_lifecycle_eval scans (before the weekly render) to decide which §13.1 calibration items are due
description: Batch-3 PRIVATE state contract (design §13 / §13.1 / §13.2 / §18.1 #20). The register is the per-§13.1-item live-forward accumulator: it carries the DATED forward_observations ledger (decision_date → contribution; live_forward_count is DERIVED as the sum, so a count cannot be self-authored without dated evidence, and re-running a decision_date is idempotent — §2.1 重跑不重复计数) + the §12.2② upgrade_margin_frozen flag + the derived `due` state (+ number/title). It deliberately does NOT carry threshold metadata — the threshold is GOVERNED: engine/us_short_lifecycle_eval.py DERIVES each item's count_type / min_count / secondary_required from us_short_lifecycle_threshold_authority by number, so the mutable private register CANNOT self-author / lower its own review threshold (R-USSHORT-BATCH3-R2-LIFECYCLE-THRESHOLD-SELF-AUTHORING-BYPASS) — additionalProperties:false here rejects a register that tries to smuggle threshold_min_count / count_type / threshold_category / a bare live_forward_count back in. It contains per-item counts and (later) ticker/performance detail, so it MUST live only on a gitignored private path (state/us_short/lifecycle/, §11.6); tracked surfaces carry only de-identified summaries. This schema pins STRUCTURE only. draft-07 cannot express: coverage (every §13.1 item enrolled, no missing/extra/duplicate — the §13 coverage insurance), the `number`/`title` cross-ref to us_short_lifecycle_calibration_governance, and the GOVERNED `due == (DERIVED live_forward_count >= governed_min_count AND (secondary_condition_met OR NOT governed_secondary_required))` invariant, the strict-real-date ledger keys, and the weeks-type 0/1-per-decision_date contribution rule — all enforced by engine/us_short_lifecycle_eval.py against the threshold authority + tests.

item.description: One §13.1 calibration item's live-forward accumulator (the dated forward_observations ledger → derived live_forward_count + upgrade_margin_frozen + derived due). additionalProperties false — it carries NO threshold metadata and NO bare live_forward_count (the threshold is governed by us_short_lifecycle_threshold_authority, derived by number); the number/title cross-ref + the governed `due` invariant are enforced by the lifecycle_eval validator, not here.

forward_observations.description: Dated live-forward ledger: decision_date (YYYYMMDD) -> that run's non-negative integer contribution. live_forward_count is DERIVED as the sum — the register stores NO bare count, so it cannot self-author a count without dated evidence (mirrors the no-self-authored-threshold rule one layer down). Idempotent by decision_date: re-running a decision_date OVERWRITES its entry, never adds (§2.1 幂等不灌前向证据 / 重跑不重复计数). For a weeks-type governed category each contribution must be 0 or 1 (one decision_date = at most one week — so a single run can't forge N weeks); the real-date keys + the weeks 0/1 rule are enforced by us_short_lifecycle_eval.py against the governed count_type, since draft-07 can express neither.
